companyDescription: AAV gene therapy developer · NAVSUNLI (RGX-121) for Hunter syndrome cleared an FDA course-reversal on its Feb 2026 CRL · RGX-202 Duchenne + AbbVie wet-AMD collaboration in the pipeline
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Roughly flat today, but up sharply since the Jun 22, 2026 FDA reversal news (a same-day pop of up to 37% premarket) that reopened the accelerated-approval path for NAVSUNLI after a Feb 2026 Complete Response Letter had sent shares down 21%.
summary: REGENXBIO's Hunter syndrome gene therapy NAVSUNLI (RGX-121) got a rare FDA course-reversal: after a February 2026 Complete Response Letter (-21% on the stock), the FDA has now aligned with the company that its existing clinical data is sufficient for the accelerated approval pathway — no new patients or studies required. A Type A meeting is expected this month (July 2026) with BLA resubmission targeted rapidly after, in Q3 2026. All 11 covering analysts rate the stock Buy with a $24.36 consensus target (+136% from here), though individual targets range widely ($10-50), reflecting real disagreement on timeline and probability, not just size. A second, separate catalyst — the RGX-202 (Duchenne) BLA submission — adds optionality but isn't the near-term driver. This is a binary regulatory-pathway stock: real upside, real prior failure on the record.

catalysts.name: FDA Type A Meeting (NAVSUNLI Path Forward)
catalysts.description: REGENXBIO expects to hold a Type A meeting with the FDA in July 2026 to finalize the resubmission path for NAVSUNLI (RGX-121) in Hunter syndrome, following the FDA's alignment that existing data supports accelerated approval without new patients or an untreated control arm.

catalysts.name: NAVSUNLI BLA Resubmission
catalysts.description: Company plans to resubmit the BLA rapidly following the Type A meeting, targeted for Q3 2026, with the FDA committing to an expedited review. A clean resubmission (no further amendments required) would be the next major de-risking step toward approval.

catalysts.name: RGX-202 (Duchenne) BLA Pathway
catalysts.description: Separate program: the AFFINITY DUCHENNE Phase III portion met its primary endpoint (93% of patients above 10% microdystrophin expression), supporting an accelerated-approval BLA strategy and a potential 2027 commercial launch — independent optionality alongside the NAVSUNLI catalyst.

risks: This is a real prior failure, not a clean story: the Feb 2026 CRL already happened once, and the FDA's own gene-therapy track record this cycle has been inconsistent (uniQure's AMT-130 saw a similar 2024 alignment reversed by the FDA in 2026) — a second reversal against REGENXBIO is a real possibility, not a tail risk
Analyst target range is unusually wide ($10-50) — this reflects genuine disagreement on approval probability and timeline, not just normal estimate noise
Cash burn: gene therapy development is capital-intensive: any new dilutive financing before an approval decision would pressure the stock independent of the regulatory news

The Type A meeting and 'Q3 2026' BLA resubmission are the company's own targets, not FDA-mandated deadlines — either could slip without new bad news, similar to how Oklo's internal criticality timeline is self-imposed
Small-cap biotech volatility cuts both ways: the same mechanics that drove the +37% pop on good news drove a -21% drop on the CRL — size accordingly

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed holds at 3.50–3.75%, but new Chair Warsh's hawkish tone has 9 of 18 officials projecting a further 2026 hike, with the next FOMC decision Jul 28–29, 2026 — just days after this report.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core inflation remains above target and the 10-year yield sits near 4.48% — a headwind for small-cap biotechs that periodically need to raise capital before reaching profitability.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Biotech regulatory catalysts are largely macro-independent — an FDA decision doesn't care about interest rates — but a small-cap name that may need financing before commercialization is more exposed to a high-rate environment raising the cost of that capital.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the FDA pathway itself is idiosyncratic and macro-independent, but REGENXBIO's small-cap size and pre-revenue balance sheet mean a hawkish surprise at the Jul 28-29 FOMC or a broader risk-off move would still pressure the stock independent of the regulatory news flow.

th.summary: ยีนบำบัด NAVSUNLI (RGX-121) ของ REGENXBIO สำหรับ Hunter syndrome ได้รับการพลิกกลับจาก FDA ที่หายาก — หลัง Complete Response Letter ก.พ. 2026 (หุ้นร่วง 21%) ตอนนี้ FDA เห็นด้วยว่าข้อมูล clinical ที่มีอยู่เพียงพอสำหรับ accelerated approval ไม่ต้องมีผู้ป่วยใหม่หรือการศึกษาเพิ่ม คาดมี Type A meeting เดือนนี้ (ก.ค. 2026) และยื่น BLA ใหม่เร็ว ๆ นี้ใน Q3 2026 นักวิเคราะห์ทั้ง 11 คน Buy หมด เป้าเฉลี่ย $24.36 (+136% จากราคานี้) แม้เป้าแต่ละรายจะกว้าง ($10-50) สะท้อนความเห็นต่างจริงเรื่อง timeline และความน่าจะเป็น ไม่ใช่แค่ noise ปกติ ยังมี catalyst แยกต่างหากคือ RGX-202 (Duchenne) BLA เป็น upside เสริม ไม่ใช่ตัวขับเคลื่อนหลักช่วงนี้ นี่คือหุ้น binary ด้าน regulatory — upside จริง แต่มีประวัติพลาดมาแล้วครั้งหนึ่งจริง
